title: Garlic Tomato Spaghetti
description: A quick weeknight pasta with a garlicky tomato sauce.
source: Adapted from a favourite cookbook (or paste a web address here)

steps.title: Start the sauce
steps.text: Warm the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the garlic and cook gently until fragrant, taking care not to brown it.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Add the tomatoes and oregano, season, and simmer until slightly thickened.

steps.title: Cook the pasta
steps.text: Boil the spaghetti in well-salted water according to the package instructions, then drain, keeping a cup of the cooking water.

steps: Toss the pasta through the sauce, loosening it with a splash of cooking water if needed. Top with Parmesan and basil, and serve.
notes: The sauce keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days.
Add a pinch of chilli flakes with the garlic for some heat.
